name: Hwarim Hyun
intro: 👋 **Hi! I'm Harley**, a systems-minded AI Safety Evaluation Engineer with five years of experience measuring how well large systems actually work, from a 50-billion-vector search index to every safety evaluation framework @ NAVER.
📊 I make safety evaluations precise and reliable enough that product teams treat them as part of building, not a gate to clear at the end.
I'm after safety users never feel and builders can act on; that's the impact I'm genuinely proud of.
✅ **Some of my best work experiences have been:**
🤖 Designing NAVER's standard AI evaluation process as the second founding member of the safety-dedicated team
📉 Building an internal automation platform and verification system that cut safety evaluation time by 80%, increased query volume 5×, and improved evaluation precision by 11.5%p
🖥️ Before safety, optimizing NAVER's search engine itself: cutting vector-search response time 50% across 10M+ searches a day and an index of 50B+ vectors

**Outside of work**, I love to sing 🎤🎵! I've been fronting bands for almost a decade, and this past year I've been running NAVER's band club (50 to 60 people, two public shows a year, and it's easily the best part of my calendar!).
📚 I also keep a small book club going at my office, nine of us at the moment. And I'm outnumbered at home by two adorable cats 🐈 🐈.
🤝 I'm always open to opportunities where I can build evaluation systems from scratch and make sure they hold up under scrutiny. Feel free to connect!
